Explicit GB specification and RHD evidence bound to that type and era, with import/mismatch context. UK registration, UK launch, locale or the unexplained RL literal alone are insufficient.

BMW or applicable type-approval format evidence for the bounded GB/RHD type, supported by a second distinct consistent sample under an authorised privacy-preserving method. Never derive descriptor = AG code + zero or copy a sampled checksum/serial.

Separately labelled manufacturer/type-era evidence and a matched plant-code allocation. Keep UK delivery launch, catalogue order/effect date, advertised year, registration year and actual production date separate.
